The '''Mystral Minstrels''' were a [[Music/Legends|musical]] group whose work was considered melodious. Their music was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the period that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Master-Com]] was [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. While Master-Com was administrator, he came to be considered a connoisseur of music, including those songs produced by the Minstrels.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mystral Minstrels were first mentioned in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].<ref name="VSV" />
